summary: More than most people, a strong will and deep reserves of energy and an appetite for more and a need to believe in something work together when you choose to use them. The opening is there: you go after what you want and don't back down, you reach, grow, and lift the room. It rewards you when you reach for it.
body: More than most people, a strong will and deep reserves of energy and an appetite for more and a need to believe in something work together when you choose to use them. The opening is there: you go after what you want and don't back down, you reach, grow, and lift the room. It rewards you when you reach for it. Big drive and ambition; focus is what turns it into results rather than waste.
gift: At your best: you go after what you want and don't back down, and you reach, grow, and lift the room.
shadow: The trap: your temper gets ahead of you, or you sit on it until it leaks out sideways — or you overreach, overpromise, or talk bigger than you deliver.
integration: Let drive and anger and growth and belief cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Big drive and ambition; focus is what turns it into results rather than waste.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you go after what you want and you reach, grow, work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Your temper gets ahead of you
Let the reflex make the decision
